title: More flexible bandpath/lattice determination
body:
Add a function to make it possible to match a cell to a specific Bravais lattice instead of determining the Bravais lattice.

This is helpful if we already know the spacegroup, and have therefore already decided what Bravais lattice it is, irrespective of how ASE measures it.

We still need a way to *actually* build the bandpath, which is kind of implemented but does not offer this flexibility at the moment.

~~Needs a test still.~~ Done
